scams.title: AI Voice Cloning Scam
scams.description: Fraudsters using AI to clone voices of family members, calling for urgent money transfers. Over 5000 cases reported in January 2026.
scams.prevention: Verify caller identity with secret questions. Don't trust voice alone. Ask something only real person would know.

scams.title: UPI QR Code Scam
scams.description: Scammers sending fake UPI QR codes via WhatsApp claiming prize money, refunds, or KYC updates. Scanning leads to instant money deduction.
scams.prevention: Never scan QR codes from unknown sources. Verify sender identity. Check if domain is official bank/payment app.

scams.title: Digital Arrest Scam
scams.description: Fake police/CBI officers video calling claiming arrest warrant, demanding money to avoid arrest. 10,000+ victims lost ₹200 crores in 2025.
scams.prevention: Police never demand money over video call. No such thing as 'digital arrest'. Report immediately to 1930.
